channel.title: Real estate · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Real estate in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−2.4).

item.title: [−2] RBI rate panel in day two; decision due October 7 with a 25 bps hike to 5.50% widely expected
item.description:
The MPC concludes tomorrow. Most economists expect the first hike since February 2023, from 5.25%. The 10-year G-Sec yield stood at 7.21% on October 5. Ongoing: expectations unchanged since last week.

Real estate: headwind (−2) — Home loans set to get dearer

Why it matters: A hike is largely priced; the statement on further tightening and the inflation forecast will move bond yields, the rupee and rate-sensitive sectors such as housing and autos.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −2, Growth outlook −1, Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] US 10-year Treasury yield hovers near 5.3%, its highest since 2002
item.description:
The 10-year yield touched a fresh 2002 high to start the week before easing to about 5.26%. It has risen about 0.46 points in a month. Ongoing.

Real estate: mild headwind (−1) — Funding costs rise

Why it matters: High US yields draw foreign money out of Indian stocks and bonds, weaken the rupee and push up Indian bond yields.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −2, Rupee −1, Bond market (G-Secs) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks
